summary: WorkOS Auth Migration - Replace Convex Auth with WorkOS AuthKit across 6 sprints: Security hardening (CSRF, token handling), landing page migration, context unification, Playwright E2E testing, and cleanup of deprecated code. Total ~473 LOC removed.

phases.description: Security hardening and landing page migration can execute in parallel as they have no dependencies on each other
